name: Pocket
description: A see-through purple handheld: backlight on by night, clear plastic by day.

radio.style: Mellow chiptune lo-fi from a handheld played under the covers
scenes: a handheld glowing purple under a duvet at midnight
the back seat of a car on a long drive home
a save point by a quiet village at dusk
a title screen left running on a bedside table
a link cable between two friends on a school bus
textures: button clicks and a low battery chirp
vinyl crackle under a tiny speaker
